subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the completed-application program for {Brand}, after my earlier email and the market read I sent on falling apply costs. If paying only for clean, deduped applications and seeing the incremental apply-throughs against a holdout is on your roadmap, I can share the role-category apply view and the validation screen this week. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back. Either way you have the context for when it is useful.
angle: direct close, easy out (release if timing wrong)
register_notes: Stage 3 EN jobs_recruitment CPS: references the original email and the earlier stages (prior note plus the market read on apply costs) in the first sentence; direct close with an easy out (release the prospect if timing is wrong); recaps the parent differentiator (pay only for clean deduped applications, holdout incrementality, role-category apply view, validation screen) without a MobUpps figure; zero question marks; {Brand}/RECIPIENT_NAME tokens kept; no sign-off, no em-dash, no curly quotes, no 'X, not Y'; native business English.
